{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Remove sentinel values (biomarker_baseline == -999.0) from analysis
# These are likely missing data
valid_data = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Check response rates by sex
response_by_sex = valid_data.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()

# Check distribution of sex across arms
sex_by_arm = valid_data.groupby(['arm', 'sex']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Check distribution of sex across severity
sex_by_severity = valid_data.groupby(['severity', 'sex']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Display
response_by_sex, sex_by_arm, sex_by_severity"}
